name: Abiluse Cassare
original_name: アビルース・カッサレ
source:
Abiluse is a magician who meets with Celica at an underground cave-like town called Funoro as he escapes from his pursuers, and offers his help and friendship to Celica. He has a pure goal of trying to create a war-free world for magical beings including his apostle Peruru

[Spoiler]
However later on he fall in love with Celica's beauty and this romantic affection soon mutates into crazed obsession as he literally throws away everything in order to obtain the goddess’s body.
translation:
Abiluse is a magician who meets with Celica at an underground cave-like town called Funoro as he escapes from his pursuers, and offers his help and friendship to Celica. He has a pure goal of trying to create a war-free world for magical beings including his apostle Peruru

[Spoiler]
However later on he fall in love with Celica's beauty and this romantic affection soon mutates into crazed obsession as he literally throws away everything in order to obtain the goddess’s body.
